temporal_facts.duration_note: Stay duration and medication course duration are independent quantities.

rules.title: Запись основного диагноза
rules.contract: Current-admission diagnosis with code equal to primary: met, otherwise unknown.

rules.title: Сверка постоянной терапии
rules.contract: Current history event code medication_reconciliation: met, otherwise unknown.

rules.title: Аллергоанамнез до назначения
rules.contract: Known or none_known allergy_review must occur AND be available by first current order: met. If valid review exists only after first order: attention; no valid review: unknown. Without orders a valid current review is met.

rules.title: Наличие выбранных наблюдений
rules.contract: Union profile observations. Every required code must have a nonempty value other than unknown/ordered within its lookback: met, otherwise unknown. Do not interpret numeric values.

rules.title: Наличие выбранных анализов
rules.contract: Union profile labs. Every required code needs a completed result within its lookback: met, otherwise unknown. Orders alone do not count. This subset is not the complete clinical workup.

rules.title: Наличие выбранных исследований
rules.contract: Union profile procedures. Every required code needs a documented result within lookback: met, otherwise unknown. Do not demand a repeat solely because a new admission occurred.

rules.title: Заполненность назначения
rules.contract: All current orders must have nonempty dose, route, frequency: met. Missing orders or any missing field: unknown. Do not assess dose correctness.

rules.title: Совпадение с записанным аллергеном
rules.contract: For each order use latest current allergy_review occurred AND available by order time. known requires comma-separated substances codes. Exact intersection with order code or class: attention. No valid prior review or empty known substances: unknown; otherwise met. No orders: not_applicable. No cross-reactivity inference.

rules.title: Разбор терапии при почечном риске
rules.contract: If renal_risk false or no current orders: not_applicable. Otherwise current renal_review: met, missing: unknown. No dose calculation or claim review preceded treatment.

rules.title: Связь назначения с диагнозом
rules.contract: Each current order indication_event_id must reference a current diagnosis available by order time: met, otherwise unknown. No orders: not_applicable. This only checks a link, not clinical appropriateness.

rules.title: Срок назначения антибиотика при ВП
rules.contract: Primary CAP only, otherwise not_applicable. First antibiotic order on or after primary diagnosis: <=14400 seconds met, later attention. No order: pending if elapsed <=14400, unknown if later. No diagnosis: unknown. Use temporal_facts.

rules.title: Назначение и фактическое введение
rules.contract: Every current administration must reference order_id with same code, available by administration time: met, otherwise attention. No administrations: not_applicable.

rules.title: Оценка ответа при ВП
rules.contract: Primary CAP only, otherwise not_applicable. A reassessment 172800..259200 seconds inclusive after first antibiotic administration: met. No start: unknown. Without timely reassessment: pending while elapsed <=259200; after deadline attention if a late assessment exists, otherwise unknown. Early assessment does not satisfy this window.

rules.title: Разбор после ухудшения
rules.contract: No current reassessment value worsening: not_applicable. A current treatment_review at or after latest worsening: met, otherwise attention. No causal claims.

rules.title: Соблюдение записанного плана
rules.contract: Latest current followup_plan with valid aware due_at. A reassessment referencing its plan_id, at/after plan and <=due: met. Otherwise pending if now<=due, unknown if overdue. No plan or invalid due: unknown. Do not invent interval.

rules.title: Поля выписки
rules.contract: No current discharge: not_applicable. Latest discharge requires nonempty details diagnosis, medication_plan, followup: met, otherwise unknown.

rules.title: Длительность курса отдельно от госпитализации
rules.contract: No medication_stop: not_applicable. Each stop must reference existing current administration start_id at/before stop: met, otherwise attention. Stay duration need not equal medication course. No clinical duration recommendation.

payload.global_contract: Adult therapy only; otherwise all not_applicable. Current means occurred_at >= admission_at. Only events occurred AND available by review are visible. A current exception whose code is a rule ID overrides that rule to unknown. Profile lookback=0 means since admission; positive days means review_at minus days. Shared codes use the shortest lookback. These are research windows, not automatic orders for repeat tests. Source documents and workflow checks are not a clinical gold standard.

CAP.name: Внебольничная пневмония
CAP.scope: Нетяжёлая ВП у взрослых, терапевтический стационар

checks.explanation: Аллергоанамнез до первого назначения антибиотика не задокументирован.
Наблюдение spo2 задокументировано в период госпитализации.
Обязательные лабораторные анализы (cbc, crp) отсутствуют в видимых событиях.
Сведения об аллергоанамнезе отсутствуют для сопоставления с назначением.
Назначение антибиотика ссылается на диагностированный диагноз CAP.
Первое назначение антибиотика выполнено в пределах 14400 секунд после диагностики ВП.
Введение препарата ссылается на соответствующий ID назначения.
Оценка ответа зафиксирована в заданном временном окне после введения антибиотика.
Зафиксировано ухудшение в переоценке (e15), но последующий разбор лечения (treatment_review) отсутствует.
Переоценка, ссылающаяся на ID плана мероприятий, не зафиксирована до истечения срока due_at.
Выписка содержит необходимые поля (диагноз, план лечения, последующее наблюдение).
Прекращение приема антибиотика ссылается на существующее введение препарата.
